subject: GelatinousSlime
advisory: Numeric inherited floor thresholds remain advisory until calibrated.
All acceptance scenes are planned. No current runtime proof or art verdict is supplied.
Showcase 1 uses the separately recorded delegated flagship pick. Later showcase grouping and test staging are agent choices.
Historical rain collection/flood/drain and archive health/memory/contact obligations remain delivery reconciliation work.

leaves.oracle_proposed: Tick-stamped read-only observations, source/deployed/list fingerprints, independent census, lossless log tap and can-fail controls. Missing or stale reads are UNMEASURED. Restoration equality is independently read back before closing recovery.
leaves.tier_reason: Actual jobs, saved identities and player-visible transitions require the running composed Biomes package and its declared dependencies with all DLC. Offline probes establish wiring and observer sensitivity.
leaves.experience: The tester can associate every result and capture with the actual scene, tick, pawn/item identity, loaded package and settings. A missing observation and an interrupted recovery remain visible in the results.
leaves.scenario: Validate job/item/health/held-pawn/archive/terrain observers against changed and missing states, consume classified Titanoslime gate rows, interrupt a persistent mutation and recover the exact entry snapshot from a durable journal.
false_pass: Expected values are printed without reading the running state
The runner exits zero while a classified gate row fails
Cleanup replaces custom settings with defaults or leaves a held pawn behind
leaves.red: The proof runner reports success after observing the wrong assembly, losing its log or failing to restore state.

leaves.experience: At ordinary play zoom, the player watches workers make and use slime meals, blocks and solvent products. A poisoned raw-slime eater gains film as poison clears. Cultivated slime grass changes under the scoped farm rule, while prepared floors and resistant workers support a viable routine.
leaves.scenario: Run normal compressor/pit/solvent bills, build and eat their outputs, compare raw-slime ingestion to untreated poison, and compare cultivated/uncultivated and opted-in/ordinary plots. false_pass: Finished products are spawned and poison is cleared by helper
Raw slime cures poison without its film fee
Every safe prepared workday is rejected by an invented perpetual-danger rule
leaves.red: The biome supplies recipes and scenery while normal work cannot produce useful outputs or raw slime gives a free cure.

The victim vanishes together with their equipment
